description: Developed compliance and payments platforms for regulatory workflows, payment operations, document access, and internal process automation using Java 17, Spring Boot, React.js, REST APIs, gRPC, and microservices architecture.
Built compliance risk prediction and policy intelligence features using XGBoost models, RAG pipelines, document retrieval, policy search, and source-grounded response generation.

Designed secure and low-latency compliance backend services using Azure Service Bus, Redis, Azure Key Vault, PostgreSQL, idempotent APIs, PII-safe processing, response validation, and 300 ms response-time optimization.

Developed healthcare policy and claims applications using Python, FastAPI, ChromaDB, Qdrant, embeddings, semantic chunking, and metadata filtering for chatbot-based policy lookup, claim checking, and claims document retrieval.

Implemented healthcare claims adjudication workflows covering fake claim detection, claim validation, final bill verification, approval/rejection support, and human-in-the-loop review for complex claim decisions.

Applied production engineering practices including API design, unit and integration testing, CI/CD deployment, secure secrets management, logging, debugging, performance tuning, and cross-functional collaboration with product, QA, DevOps, and domain teams.

highlights: Contributed to ML model development and deployment workflows
Worked on data pipelines and optimization of ML systems
Worked on backend systems using Java and Spring Boot
Built a full-stack Student Portal using Java, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL, React.js, and REST APIs for attendance, grade management, and user access workflows, supporting 1,000+ active users.

Implemented JWT-based authentication, role-based access control for admin, faculty, and student users, normalized database schemas, and delivered the portal within a 10-week timeline while reducing manual administrative effort
Built foundation in scalable application design
